name: switch
description: Labeled on/off row. The words are the control; the switch is the picture.
avoidWhen: Do not place a naked Material Switch next to a Text; use this row. Do not use for exclusive choices; use radio.

ux.behaviour: Title, optional description, and a trailing switch read as one Switch
ux.why: Six spoken pieces for one setting is noise

ux.behaviour: The whole row is 48 dp, scales while pressed, and fires a click
ux.why: You tap the words, not a 20 dp thumb
On and off should feel different from a miss

aiHints: Pass the title as text; do not put a Switch beside a Text yourself
The Switch onCheckedChange is null; the row owns the tap
